data.cultural_impact: The name Peter has been popular throughout history and has been a common name among Christians due to its association with St. Peter, one of the most revered figures in Christianity. The name Peter is often given to children as a strong and solid name, symbolizing strength and stability.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Peter symbolizes foundation and stability in their faith. Peter was chosen by Jesus to be the rock upon which He would build His church. This name reminds us of the solid foundation of our faith in God, and the strength and steadfastness that we need to maintain our relationship with Him. Additionally, Peter was a disciple who made mistakes and struggled, showing that even those who make mistakes can be used by God in powerful ways. Therefore, this name also serves as a reminder of God's mercy and forgiveness.
